message: たった一人の図書館司書

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey Synn, about this ledger」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, is something wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wanted to check past accounting records for reference, but I can't find them」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, weren't they kept on the reference shelves or something...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, if that's what you mean, I think they were probably sorted out before the Student Council changed hands」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Ria
message: 「Pretty old records had piled up, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Does that mean they already threw them out or something?」

name: Ria
message: 「Nope, don't worry」

name: Ria
message: 「They should be stored in the library vault right now」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I didn't even know there was a vault」

name: Ria
message: 「It's literally a place for storing important books and records」

name: Ria
message: 「Though if I remember right, you can't go inside without Melilot-san's permission」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Your face looks bad, Miss Treasurer. Did something happen?」

name: Misa
message: 「You mean complexion...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha... I'm just not very good with that librarian」

name: Misa
message: 「I think she's a lovely, mature, and wonderful person, though」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All I can picture is getting lectured about borrowing books」

name: Ria
message: 「Aah~ That's a rite of passage for first-years~\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it's not like I dislike her or anything, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll go borrow them for you instead」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, are you sure?」

name: Synn
message: 「I just finished my own work, and you still have tasks left, right, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry about that, I owe you one!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, I'll be back in a bit」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please be careful, President!」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It's not like Melilot-san is a bad person or anything...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Always the soft touch, aren't ya」

name: Synn
message: 「My hands are free, so what's the harm?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, do whatever you want, I guess」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me--」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Yes, yes, can I help you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd like to see the librarian, Melilot-san」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Ahh, if you're looking for Melilot-san, I think she's probably over that way organizing books」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so. Thanks」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「No, no, you're welcome」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「...Is something wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you always the only one on library duty?」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Well, the librarian is a pretty hard person to please」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「She even organizes all those books entirely by herself」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
I wonder if we'll get kicked out if we chatter too much.

name: Synn
message: 「It's surprisingly big, isn't it, this library」

name: Paqy
message: 「Chattering away right off the bat--leave it to the Demon Lord. You've got guts」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, it's not like the librarian's gonna eat me alive or anything...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is there something wrong with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhyah!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please keep quiet inside the library」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Ah, sorry about that...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...You seemed quite lively for someone talking to themselves, though」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Ahaha...」

name: Melilot
message: 「So, do you have some business with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oops, right, I do」

name: Synn
message: 「I was hoping to borrow some past Student Council records」

name: Melilot
message: 「Past records...?」

name: Synn
message: 「I heard they're kept in the library's archives」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, indeed」

name: Melilot
message: 「We hold onto the materials that the Student Council room can no longer manage」

name: Synn
message: 「Could I get permission to enter the archives?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I'm terribly sorry, but I cannot allow that」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Melilot
message: 「As a rule, general students are prohibited from entering the archival stacks」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, is that how it is...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes」

name: Synn
message: 「Is there any way you could make an exception?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I didn't say you couldn't view the records at all, you know」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if you simply say 'past records,' I imagine there are quite a variety of them...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! Um, accounting records」

name: Synn
message: 「For preparing for KiraFes, I was hoping there might be something I could use as a reference for the ledgers」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see. Please wait a moment」

name: Melilot
message: 「Will these do?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, these are fine」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that so. I'm glad I could be of help」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for putting you through the trouble」

name: Melilot
message: 「It was hardly any trouble at all. Please don't worry about it」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, being able to pick out this many accurate materials in such a short time is amazing」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I'm used to this kind of work」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, you manage all the books by yourself too, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Being alone is easier on the mind」

name: Synn
message: 「Have you been the librarian here for a long time, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's still only been a few years, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Why do you ask?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, no, I was just curious, I guess」

name: Melilot
message: 「Curious about me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I suppose so」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're an unusual student, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, you think so...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, I do」
Did I say something that rubbed Melilot-san the wrong way...?

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, shouldn't you be heading back already?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone must be waiting for you, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, that's true. Well then」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good luck with the KiraFes preparations」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, thank you very much」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san really is a nice person, isn't she」

name: Paqy
message: 「'Really is'? Weren't you two already acquainted?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd never really talked with her properly until now, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka should just drop that weird awkwardness around her too」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's with you, you're in a weirdly good mood」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, whatever」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, I've gotta hurry up and hand these materials over to Nanaka!」
